messages.summary:
## Objective
- Recreate *My Summer Car* as a complete, playable browser game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Build it now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport ≤1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original, lightweight Finnish summer-car game called *Summer Wrench*, with a garage repair phase and a first-person-style gravel-road driving phase.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added title, illustrated garage, car repair tasks, driving controls, HUD, obstacles, condition/distance tracking, pause, win, and failure states in `index.html`.
- Extracted styling into `style.css`.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript implementation in `game.js`; the complete game script was drafted in conversation but has not yet been written to a file.
- Run syntax and gameplay checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser check was blocked because Chromium is not installed (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`); no screenshot was captured.
- An earlier syntax-check attempt failed because `index.html` no longer had an inline `<script>` tag after restructuring.

## Next Move
1. Create `game.js` with the game logic already drafted in the conversation, ensuring it matches the DOM in `index.html`.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and resolve any issues.
3. Test in a browser if possible; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize the finished game and note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and DOM structure; references `style.css` and `game.js`.
- `style.css`: Game styling and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The intended game code includes canvas-drawn scenery and driving, WASD/arrow and touch controls, four clickable repair hotspots, and a 1.8 km village trip.
